Name: Custom Movie Under The Sea
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[b][u][size=6]Under The Sea[/size]

[/u][/b][size=3]Adds a custom movie to the Movie Theater in spring. I made it really fast because I couldn't figure out how to use the framework. Hopefully it will be better documented in the future when people see it's potential!

[/size][size=5][b][u]Installation
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
﻿- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4737]Custom Movies[/url]﻿

[/size][size=5][b][u]Config
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]I don't really know how the Custom Movies framework mod works, but you can open content.json and test things yourself. There is also an example mod on the Custom Movies mod page.

[/size][size=5][u][b]Extra
[/b][/u][/size][size=3]I might update this with better music / sounds / effects, once I learn how to use the framework.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Tweaked some sounds and NPC responses.
